name: higgsfield-notifier
description: Browser extension that notifies you when a Higgsfield generation finishes or fails.

scripts.lint:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox
scripts.package:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir release --filename higgsfield-notifier-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.dev:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist-firefox --start-url https://higgsfield.ai
